title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Night With Just The Three Of Us〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: A Night With Just The Three Of Us（2★）
meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Humhumhum♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Thank goodness we finished that song.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ena still didn't seem that satisfied, but we finally get to take a breather.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hope she gets to relax a little during our afterparty...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(They're already here.
But I don't think they've seen me yet.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Scout?
rows.Line:
“Whoa, check out you three!
Hey, how would you cuties feel about modeling for a hair salon?”

rows.Speaker: Scout?
rows.Line: “You might get noticed by someone working for a big fashion zine. Who knows?”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: M-Model?! For a fashion magazine?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Nice! Sounds like you're on board♪”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, it's you. For a second there, I thought...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Geez, you're the worst...
Even as a joke, that's pretty low.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you seemed so excited, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I saw that look on your face.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me? Who wouldn't be excited? I can ignore some dimwit hitting on me, but someone calling themselves a veteran scout's a completely different story.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that, but who else among us would get all giddy about something like this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd refuse flat out.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too... I'd probably run, literally...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh? Neither of you were interested in what this “scout” had to say?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which means this little lie was planned with me in mind from the start, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh, well...
Hey, the light just turned green! Let's cross♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Mizuki, wait! We're not done here!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena seems much better now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: As obnoxious as ever too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! I heard that, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, just chill.
C'mon, Kanade, Mafuyu, let's go!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here's to another job well done!
Cheers♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Kanade
rows.Line: Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To apologize for my little stunt earlier, Ena, I'll buy you any dessert of your choosing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? You mean it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unless you don't want anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, a giant parfait might do the trick.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Can't you show me some pity?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Were you working on a painting before you got here, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your sleeve. There's some paint on it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way! Ugh... It's just a drop, but you're right. It must've gotten on me when I was cleaning up...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Luckily, you should be able to wash that off no problem.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You were working on another painting today?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. The only way for me to learn how to be more expressive is by drawing and painting as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's gonna be a long process, but I don't plan on quitting any time soon.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
From time to time, Ena...
You become this absolutely incredible person.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I understand what Mizuki means.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No one asked you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Actually studying art, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Kanade and Mafuyu keep finding new ways to express themselves, and Ena's really starting to hit the books.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That means I can't drag my feet.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Especially since all their work goes to waste if my videos aren't really up to snuff.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'll get some books and stuff to learn more about editing videos!)
